notes.title: Dev Diary #4 New Biome : Desert
notes.content:
[h2][b]🌵 First Biome Reveal: The Desert[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-01-2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally reveal the first of four biomes in [i]Nomad Drive[/i] — [b]the Desert Biome[/b]![/p][p]This arid, desolate, and scorching environment hides a variety of mysterious locations and unexpected encounters. Even though the sunbaked roads seem to stretch into nothingness, curiosity is your best compass — keep moving forward, and you might be surprised by what you find.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🗺️ First Points of Interest (POIs)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to share the first three Points of Interest (POIs) that players will be able to explore. In [i]Nomad Drive[/i], POIs come in [b]small[/b] and [b]large[/b] variants, offering different levels of interaction and rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🏭 Abandoned Factory[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-05-1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-06-1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our first [b]large POI[/b] — the [i]Abandoned Factory[/i] — consists of three distinct buildings and a multi-level layout. It’s designed to be a high-reward area where players can spend a significant amount of time scavenging and exploring. Hidden surprises await those who dig deep.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🪵 Wooden Cabin 01[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-03-1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-04.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first of many modular [b]Wooden Cabins[/b], this structure will appear in different variations across the game world. It’s compact, story-rich, and crafted to spark exploration.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚗 Car Wreckage 01[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-01-3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-02-2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A scattered junk site featuring a derelict car. This is the first of many car wreckage variants players can encounter in the wastelands — perfect for quick looting and storytelling moments.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🛠️ Tech Deep Dive[/b][/h2][p]Let’s take a look at some of the systems powering [i]Nomad Drive[/i] under the hood:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌍 Terrain Generation System[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]Nomad Drive[/i] uses an [b]infinite, seed-based chunk system[/b] to generate its terrain procedurally. This means every seed gives players a unique world, while shared seeds offer identical experiences — perfect for community challenges or multiplayer consistency.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/e774c4233149ec9db6bb9ec798cb2dca13e81a6e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the system is focused on generating our first biome, the Desert. Future biomes — including snowy highlands and dense forests — will be integrated into this system over time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛣️ Road Generation System – DivisionRoads[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re developing a custom procedural road system called [b]DivisionRoads[/b]. This system creates biome-specific roads with elevation shifts, smooth curves, and dynamic layout logic. Roads are guaranteed to pass near key POIs to maintain meaningful world flow.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/df5be029d8738f64b65a63fdf0dcbfbbc86ba869.gif"][/img][/p][p]The terrain and vegetation auto-adjust to the road’s path, and we’ve developed modules that allow game objects — signs, power poles, debris, etc. — to be placed seamlessly along roads. The result: endless roads that feel handcrafted and immersive.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌿 Vegetation System[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://indiedevil.com/content/images/2025/07/Screenshot-07.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each biome in [i]Nomad Drive[/i] features its own [b]procedural vegetation package[/b], tailored to its environment. Our system ensures realistic placement, density, and variety — making every biome feel alive and visually distinct.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧭 POI Spawning System[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Still in early development, our POI spawning system analyzes terrain and player progression to dynamically place POIs throughout the world.[/p][p]Rather than relying on static spawns, the system uses a weighted algorithm to decide which POI should appear next — making exploration feel organic and non-repetitive. Many POIs are modular, and all are procedurally populated with loot and interactive elements, ensuring a fresh experience every time.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Development[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re actively working to bring [i]Nomad Drive[/i]’s entire gameplay experience into a [b]multiplayer environment[/b].[/p][p]Our main character design is currently underway, and we can’t wait to introduce you to them — along with core [b]co-op mechanics[/b] — in a future devlog.[/p][p]All of the systems mentioned above are being built with multiplayer support in mind, which presents its own unique challenges. But we’re making steady progress and are excited about what’s to come.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Thank You[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for reading! If you’re as excited as we are, please [b]share Nomad Drive[/b] with your friends and help spread the word.[/p][p]We’ll see you in the next Dev Diary — until then, stay curious and keep exploring!

[/p][table colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/1fb9a308322abf93a79c77e45558004d8ff8832c.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/13fdfaf1915c77bb8b121965e131d5a640da886f.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/8338be9aacc189d7102542cd9bc098f6e503580d.png"][/img]

The [i]Nomad Drive[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 Co-op & Planting
notes.content:
Hello again, everyone! We are excited to share the latest development update for Nomad Drive. This update covers the following key topics.

[h2]Update Topics[/h2]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer(Co-op) Basics
[*] Planting System
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer(Co-op) Basics[/h2]

Nomad Drive was initially planned as a single-player game. However, based on the feedback from our community, we decided to shift our focus toward developing a multiplayer(co-op) experience. This decision required us to rework all existing features and mechanics of the game to make them suitable for a co-op environment. As the process of adapting the game to a co-op infrastructure was both time-consuming and labor-intensive, the development of new mechanics and features had to be paused.

[i][b]Nomad Drive will be playable both in single-player and co-op modes.[/b][/i]

Currently, not all of the game’s existing features and mechanics have been fully integrated into the multiplayer(co-op) system, but we are making swift progress. For this development update, we can only share the new planting mechanic with you. Since the last update, a significant portion of our time has been dedicated to building the foundation of the multiplayer experience. Meanwhile, our work on the art side is continuing at full speed. Below, we've shared a few chill images from our planting system—we hope you enjoy them!

[h2]Planting System[/h2]

In the world of Nomad Drive, you can find seed packets for the following vegetables and fruits, along with a variety of unique planters:

[list]
[*] Tomato
[*] Potato
[*] Watermelon
[*] Orange
[*] Apple
[/list]

You can plant the seeds you find into planters and care for them regularly. The plants go through a total of 5 distinct growth stages, requiring consistent watering. Once a plant reaches maturity and bears fruit, it can be harvested, and the collected produce can be consumed by the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/6ff06bad89ae0927df72a4e6050a07742feb905d.jpg[/img]

[i][b]While vegetables can only be harvested once, fruit trees provide a steady supply of fruit with a single planting.** This makes growing fruit trees a longer but more effective strategy over time.[/b][/i]

Just like with non-harvestable plants, you can place and arrange your planters anywhere inside your campervan, adding a touch of decoration to your space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/6e8070635a26c9a246a1136dff7f3e1246c41c97.jpg[/img]

Another key aspect of the planting system is the fertilization feature. When the player uses the restroom inside their campervan, a composting mechanism is activated, producing fertilizer. This fertilizer can significantly reduce the growth time of your plants, helping them mature faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/961027454fdce68f3441c601590a2563d84ab070.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/630724f53cfd6847b311377b4659413f085fec51.jpg[/img]

The variety of fruits you can grow and harvest in the game is limited to these for now, but adding new vegetable and fruit trees based on community requests will be a quick and easy process.

You can register for the alpha test program that will be opened soon from the alpha tester registration page on our website.

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 Object Placement & Cooking
notes.content:
Greetings, Nomads,

There have been a number of updates to Nomad Drive since we last met and we would now like to update you on these developments.

This development report covers the following topics.

[list]
[*] Advanced object placement system
[*] Cooking mechanics and stoves
[*] Life cycle mechanics of fruits and packaged foods
[/list]

[h2]Advanced Object Placement System[/h2]

Practically all objects in the game world can be grabbed and conveniently placed in areas that cover all the important planes of the game, which have been set in detail in advance. This gives the player the opportunity to create their own free game world. You will be able to place all objects you pick up at any angle and in any area you want.

    For example, you can take a painting you found during your journey and place it anywhere you want in your caravan at any angle you want.

💡[i]You can see how the object placement system works in the cooking mechanics demonstration video below.[/i]

[h2]Cooking Mechanics & Stoves[/h2]

At Nomad Drive, we have two types of stoves: electric and gas. Electric stoves work by using the electricity supply in your caravan and allow you to cook food. Gas stoves use your caravan's gas supply and allow you to cook food. The stoves are positioned from old to new as the game progresses, and you'll have a better chance of discovering better quality stoves as you progress.

The meat you find on your journey can be cooked and, when cooked, gives the player significant advantages. Each food has four different cooking states (raw, rare, well done, burnt). To cook a meat, you need a pan. The pan is also a lootable object during your journey in the game.

[previewyoutube=dnPnqZr9O0w;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The correct cooking time for each food is a detail to be discovered by experimenting in the game.[/i]

[h2]Life cycle mechanics of fruits and packaged foods[/h2]

All food, drinks and fruits in the game's world have a lifespan. When food reaches the end of its lifespan, it spoils and becomes harmful when consumed. For this reason, the player should keep the looted food refrigerated in the caravan or consume it within a short time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/0c9ddcacda972795c93673eadcb0e2c3cd98b7b0.jpg[/img]

Packaged products have a much longer life expectancy than fruit, vegetables and meat. Canned food, on the other hand, is practically indestructible throughout the game, making it an important source of food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064040/3bac9750ec3a6bf9dad7519923f5efefda84f5a6.jpg[/img]

You can register for the alpha test program that will be opened soon from the alpha tester registration page on our website.
